assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are the maintainers' provisional rough ranges (provisional_constraint); they are used for AI generation, self-check and display only.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive metrics must be recalculated when official polygons replace the provisional ones; content scoring is not blocked by the organiser's geometry gap.

assumptions.statement: Land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing and AI inn nodes are concept suggestions generated by the AI agent to illustrate spatial structure and scenario organisation.
assumptions.impact: No statutory planning, engineering, ownership, investment or implementation conclusion is implied; professional teams may deepen or replace any layer.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, test scenarios, annual events and operation mechanisms are concept proposals, not approved operations or confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Privacy and human-review boundaries apply to every AI scenario; deployment claims remain pending feasibility and approval procedures.

assumptions.statement: Global AI ecosystem case references are limited to publicly verifiable information registered as background_only in sources.json (CASE-*); no company lists, investment amounts, output values or fiscal commitments are asserted.
assumptions.impact: Case study tables remain methodological references and must not be read as verified industrial facts.

assumptions.statement: The Inn-Token authorisation mechanism (one token per section, no token no entry, human handoff, degradable) is an original design concept inspired by the historical Jing-Zhang railway staff-and-token block system; it is not a regulatory or licensing scheme.
assumptions.impact: The token mechanism is a spatial-organisation and governance metaphor for professional deepening; no licensing or data-authority implication is asserted.

assumptions.statement: The pilot section (AI Origin inn + Xiaoyuehe test corridor) and the three independently pausable project packages are concept suggestions for low-cost, reversible implementation.
assumptions.impact: Pilot scope, staffing and budget figures are conceptual estimates, not commitments; professional feasibility and budgeting are required.

assumptions.statement: Staffing estimates (one station manager, two operations, three service desk per inn, volunteer rotation) are concept-level calculations for discussion.
assumptions.impact: No staffing or budget commitment is made; professional HR and financial planning must confirm actual figures.

assumptions.statement: The emergency-response matrix (fallback per AI scenario, trigger conditions, response times, responsible roles) is a concept plan requiring operator drills and confirmation.
assumptions.impact: The matrix does not constitute an approved safety or emergency plan.

assumptions.statement: Inclusive personas, account-free and smartphone-free fallback paths, and appeal-correction mechanisms follow the Barrier-Free Environment Law and the elderly smart-technology plan (background-level references).
assumptions.impact: Accessibility provisions are design suggestions aligned with public law; detailed barrier-free design requires professional accessibility audits.

assumptions.statement: All figures, PDFs, HTML and geometry are generated by the declared AI agent with cleared public sources; fonts are Noto Sans CJK (SIL OFL 1.1); the machine-readable rights ledger is in visual/assets/rights-ledger.json.
assumptions.impact: The rights ledger supports human verification; any third-party material added later must be registered before use.

assumptions.statement: This package is submitted for repository intake and community display (COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY); gallery publication, award selection and government endorsement are separate decisions by maintainers and organisers.
assumptions.impact: Intake acceptance does not imply gallery publication, awards or endorsement.

assumptions.statement: All known metrics are recomputed from submitted geometry in EPSG:4548; metrics with official-data dependencies (FAR, heights, densities) remain unknown with reasons until official regulatory conditions are published.
assumptions.impact: Metrics are reproducible from the submitted layers; precision-sensitive values are provisional-boundary dependent.

assumptions.statement: Regional synergy relationships (Beiwei, Future Science City, Huairou, ETDA, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei) are research hypotheses expressed as interfaces; no formal cooperation is claimed.
assumptions.impact: Formal synergy requires confirmation by organisers and professional teams against planning and industrial policy.

assumptions.statement: Historical statements about the Jing-Zhang railway and its staff-and-token block system are based on public historical knowledge (registered as background references); no unauthorised images, portraits or proprietary materials are used.
assumptions.impact: Cultural narrative is a public-knowledge interpretation for design inspiration, subject to professional historical review.
